text:
Tara (People Ops): Quick thread - Omar H's I-9/background intake needs an alternate flow. Candidate is in IST and passport renewal is pending (receipt only). Vendor won't clear with receipt alone. Day-1 planned Tue 6/18 08:30 PT.

Priya - Background Ops: Vendor requires either a current govt ID or a certified notary attestation plus proof of renewal receipt + selfie. For international joins we can accept a video-notarized I-9 equivalent plus local notary confirmation.

Omar H (candidate): Hi! I have the passport renewal receipt and a scanned national ID (no photo page updated yet). I can book a local notary this Friday afternoon IST. Also, shipment address changed to a family member's address temporarily.

Tara (People Ops): Thanks Omar. Can you upload: renewal_receipt.pdf, national_id.pdf, and a selfie holding your ID to the secure portal by EOD Thu IST? If not, we'll need to postpone Day-1 to give vendor time.

Zoe (Benefits): benefits update - contractors get meal+commuter; enrollment link sent within 14 days. If start slips >7 days, we need manager OK to extend the window.

Nick (Hiring Manager): I can approve up to 5 business days if needed. We prefer Omar starts sooner but not at the expense of clearing.

IT Fulfillment: Placed laptop on hold under ticket `FUL-2024-112`. Express ship available once address is confirmed. Please DM address to IT Fulfillment to avoid PII in channel.

RecruitingBot: Reminder: candidate offer accepted on 2024-06-01. If start date moves, update req in Greenhouse.

Priya - Background Ops: If Omar can do video-notary Fri IST, vendor can clear by Mon morning PST. Propose new plan:\n
```
- Upload docs (renewal_receipt + national_id + selfie) by 2024-06-13 EOD IST
- Video-notary appointment: 2024-06-14 16:00 IST
- Vendor re-run + clearance: 2024-06-17 morning PST
- New Day-1 orientation (tentative): 2024-06-18 08:30 PT (confirm after clearance)
```

Omar H (candidate): I'll upload tonight and book the notary for 6/14 16:00 IST. Thanks for the flexibility.

Tara (People Ops): Nick - tagging you to confirm stipend window extension (up to 5 business days).

Nick (Hiring Manager): Confirmed. Extend stipend enrollment window.

Zoe (Benefits): Noted. I'll queue the enrollment link to go live on the confirmed start date and allow the 5-day grace.

Tara (People Ops): TL;DR — candidate will do video-notary, uploads due tonight, we tentatively keep 6/18 start but will finalize after vendor clears. I'll update calendar and send the checklist via DM. :white_check_mark:

Omar H (candidate): Done - uploaded `renewal_receipt.pdf` and `national_id.pdf`. Booked notary. Thank you everyone!
